text_block_list.text: Hey, did you see who's running today?
text_block_list.name: Spectator with Hat

text_block_list.text:
I saw! It's that Umamusume from abroad,
right?
text_block_list.name: Spectator in Button Up

text_block_list.text:
No, not her! I'm talking about the one
who was on
TV the other day! I'm a huge
fan.
text_block_list.name: Spectator with Hat

text_block_list.text:
On TV? Wait, you can't mean... No way,
she's
here?!
text_block_list.name: Spectator in Button Up

text_block_list.text:
Oh, this takes me back a bit! I used to
follow all
of Спешл Уик's races, so I
saw her as well. I was
just thinking that
it's been a while since I've heard

anything about her.
text_block_list.name: Spectator in Button Up

text_block_list.text:
What are you talking about? She's the
hot topic
right now! Wait, is she really in
the same year as
Spe?!
text_block_list.name: Spectator with Hat

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. At any rate, I always found her to
be a
little eccentric, but it turns out
she's pretty
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Spectator with Hat

text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you hear? There's a guest
runner from
abroad in today's Yasuda
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Not that it matters to me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Either way, you're going to win.

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! That's right! No one can stand
in my
way!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I'll leave everyone in the dust!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
